description: Creates a version of the item in a new language based on an existing language version.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

doNotCopyFields.description: Creates a new version in the target language but does not copy field values from the original language.

fields.description: Extra Sitecore field names to include, e.g. ['Title']. Ignored when full is true.

full.description: Return the unprojected .NET object graph. Very large (100,000+ chars/item); diagnostics only.

id.description: The id of the item to add version for. Supply this or path.

ignoredFields.description: List of fields that should not be copied over from original item.

language.description: Language that will be used as source language. If not specified the current user language will be used.

path.description: The path of the item to add version for (e.g. /sitecore/content/Home). Supply this or id.

recurse.description: Process the item and all of its children.

name: common-add-item-version
